system.description:
Control plant growth and movement in a given area. Plants return to normal after the effect ends.

  • Level 1: 10 cm radius; plants grow x3
  • Level 2: 1 m radius; plants grow x10
  • Level 3: 10 m radius; plants grow x30
  • Level 4: 100 m radius; plants grow x100
  • Level 5: 1 km radius; plants grow x300
  • Level 6: 10 km radius; plants grow x1000
